summary: Reviewed the PR #4887 patch (CASSANDRA-21113) from the cass-persistence-compat lens. The patch changes PasswordObfuscator.obfuscate(query, opts) to CQL-escape single quotes in the password and wrap it in Pattern.quote() before building the regex, plus adds tests and a CHANGES.txt line. Applied the bundled checklist resources.md (all 26 items) to the patch and to its callers in AuditLogManager, QueryEvents, CreateRoleStatement and AlterRoleStatement. Most items do not apply: there is no serialization, serializedSize, stream wrapping, ByteBuffer, AutoCloseable, file IO, metric, background task, config or retry code in the diff. The one new path (regex construction) has no new resource or observability side effects, and the old PatternSyntaxException path that could escape into audit logging is removed, not added. No new logging or exception text carries the password. Nothing was skipped; all three changed files were reviewed in full. No mixed-version, serialization or SSTable/commit-log surface is touched.
